answer: Charge each identity a fee that rises with its own activity: the k-th attestation in an epoch costs 0.1 x k POA, refunded only if a later jury upholds it. A lone honest falcon doing 20 checks pays about 21 POA and gets it back; a swarm splitting the same spam across 1,000 fakes still pays registration per fake, and every unrefunded fee is burned, so faking volume costs real tokens. Weakness: splitting volume across fakes keeps each fee low, so registration also carries a 50 POA floor; at that price, a pearl of cheap accounts becomes a fable.
